login.err_link_invalid: The login link from Dash is not valid.

login.err_link_used: The login link from Dash was already used.
login.sso_waiting: Waiting for the Windows sign-in. Finish it in the window that opened.
login.sso_popup: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
login.sso_no_user: Windows could not tell who you are. Open this site from your company computer, or sign in with your password.
login.sso_denied: Your Windows account has no active Dash account. Sign in with your password or ask an administrator.
login.sso_mismatch: The sign-in could not be matched to this browser. Try again, and use the same browser and computer for both steps.
login.sso_expired: The sign-in took too long or was already used. Try again.
login.sso_busy: Too many sign-ins are waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
login.sso_timeout: The Windows sign-in did not finish in time. Try again.
login.sso_cancelled: The Windows sign-in window was closed before it finished.
login.sso_error: The Windows sign-in did not work. Try again, or sign in with your password.
login.sso_unavailable: The Windows sign-in cannot be completed right now: the user accounts cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
login.none: Signing in on this page is not set up on this server. Open the page from the Dash application instead.

tour.back.title: Back to Dash
tour.back.text: Returns to the home page of this server (the Dash application).
tour.theme.title: Light or dark
tour.theme.text: Switches between the light and dark themes. Until you use it, the page follows your system setting; after that this browser remembers your choice.
tour.lang.title: Language
tour.lang.text: Switches the whole page between English and 中文. This browser remembers your choice.
tour.help.title: Documentation and Guide
tour.help.text: The book opens the user guide for the current page in a new tab. The compass starts this step-by-step page guide again at any time.
tour.account.title: Your account
tour.account.text: Shows who you are signed in as. Press the button next to your name to sign out of dash_go.
tour.signin.title: Sign in
tour.signin.text: Sign in with your Dash account (password or Windows SSO) to open protected pages.
tour.landing_modules.title: Available modules
tour.landing_modules.text: Choose a module below to open its page. Clicking the CIM EDGE logo at the top left always brings you back here.
tour.help_toc.title: Contents
tour.help_toc.text: Jump straight to the section of the user guide you need.
tour.help_body.title: User guide
tour.help_body.text: Buttons and labels are written the way they appear on screen, in the language you chose at the top.
